description: history.export is the SAME query as history.list (H3) — the only difference is the rows are returned for NDJSON emission, not a table. It shares historyQuery, so the two cannot produce different rows: a second query here could drop a loop or re-floor a cost the list shows, and this fixture is the one that would catch it. It carries the same rows shape and no statement, for an exported set that is non-empty.
